scope: All 53 existing Tiny Planner screens and relevant editable module masters
counts_note: Checks of different criteria can include the same layer. Found starts with violations of the numerical rule in the baseline. Corrected counts include replacements with reusable native constructions. A2 tests the geometry of identified icon wells, not perceived optical weight. A7 counts seven measured layout gaps; visual whitespace was reviewed on all screen previews. A8 also checks pairs of visible text boxes on the same modal layer. Prototype interactions were compared to the original node data.

inspection_limitations: MCP reports geometric layer bounds. Optical centering and intentional decorative overlaps were reviewed visually.
The audit applies to the 390 × 844 design and saved example content. It does not measure app-runtime behavior or unprovided content.
